_comment: PSC-Guard probe: the production config with the scheme list cut to the three
policies the Part 1 Definition of Done needs, and a separate results_dir so it
cannot clobber the full run's outputs.
There is no --schemes flag on run_all.sh; schemes come from experiment.schemes
here (mfs.py forwards them to run_mixes.py --schemes). Restricting the list is
the supported way to replay a subset.
Cost: 3 schemes x 10 mixes instead of 23 x 10, so roughly 1/8 of a full replay.
Success criterion (RESCUE_PLAN Part 1.7): on both lbm17 mixes psc-guard must
reach hit_rate_delta >= -0.005 with rli_direct > 0, and on the other eight its
wear vector must stay within 2% of plain psc (the reservation never binds).

traces.clock_hz_note: Ignored unless the Sim_seconds cross-check fails. The first trace column is a gem5 tick (1 ps); prep_trace derives and verifies the time base from the trace header. See docs/DRY_RUN.md section 1.

experiment._array_note: 16 MB, 12 NVM + 4 SRAM ways, 64 B lines - the configuration shipped in HyCSim config.json by the tool authors, which is the configuration these traces were exported under.
experiment._ai_traces_note: Every file containing '.champsimtrace' and ending .xz/.gz under this root joins the ChampSim batch automatically (clip/rwkv .gz traces included). The ML-*.zip archive parts must be EXTRACTED in place first - traces inside zips are invisible to the walker. Directory absent = silently skipped. If champsim_ai_traces_manifest exists (produced by stage5_champsim/screen_ai_traces.py) it is authoritative and this directory walk is skipped entirely - screened, auditable trace selection instead of everything under the root.
experiment._champsim_note: 16 traces chosen for write intensity and suite coverage, not convenience. SPEC CPU2017 matches the manuscript; PARSEC, GAP and XSBench are the suites the audit says are missing; STREAM is the write-saturated bound. The 200+ CRC2 and Pythia traces are omitted deliberately - CRC2 is SPEC CPU2006 and duplicates the HyCSim mixes, and Pythia is a simulator checkout, not traces.
